skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Keep balance and perform agile physical maneuvers.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: Recall knowledge about spells, magic, planes, and magical creatures.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Climb, jump, swim, grapple, or perform other feats of strength.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Convincingly conceal or distort the truth.

skills.name: History
skills.description: Recall historical events, cultures, wars, and people.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Discern a creature's intentions or state of mind.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Influence others through threats or force of presence.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Analyze clues, traps, puzzles, ciphers, and mechanisms.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Identify or treat injuries, ailments, and causes of death.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Recall knowledge about terrain, plants, weather, and natural creatures.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Notice concealed creatures, objects, sounds, and other details.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Entertain or hold attention through artistic expression.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Influence others through honest appeal and social tact.

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: Recall knowledge about deities, rites, cults, and religious creatures.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Perform precise or concealed manual actions.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Track, navigate, forage, and endure wilderness conditions.
